title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_rasmus_pa_farten_by_astrid_lindgren_kirsten_raagaard_knqcg (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_rasmus_pa_farten_by_astrid_lindgren_kirsten_raagaard_knqcg' contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or running.
